title: Regular grocery purchase on the customer's own phone
narrative: A long-standing customer buys $64.20 of groceries, close to their usual spend, on the phone they have used for months, from a home broadband IP in their billing country. No other purchases in the past hour and only a handful today.
rationale: Every signal is consistent with the customer's established behavior: normal amount, normal frequency, trusted device, home location. Any outcome other than approve is a false positive.
